settings.title: From install to
settings.intro: No migration marathon, no IT ticket. Stratus gets your files backed up and synced in the time it takes to make coffee.

steps.title: Install the app
steps.text: Download Stratus on your laptop, phone, and tablet. Sign in once and every device is connected in seconds.

steps.title: Choose your folders
steps.text: Point Stratus at the folders you care about — Documents, Photos, Projects — and it starts syncing instantly, in the background.

steps.title: Invite your team
steps.text: Share folders with granular permissions. Everyone sees the latest version, and edits merge without conflicts or lost work.

steps.title: Forget it's there
steps.text: Stratus runs quietly in the background, backing up as you work. When you need a file, it's on every device, always current.

settings.note: Most people are fully backed up within 15 minutes of installing — no manual uploads, no waiting on a progress bar.

settings.title: Storage that works
settings.intro: A cloud drive only helps if it's fast, safe, and effortless. Stratus is designed to be all three — so you never think about your files again.

features.title: Real-time sync
features.text: Save a file and it's on every device within seconds. Our delta sync only uploads the changed bits, so it's fast even on slow connections.

features.title: End-to-end encryption
features.text: Your files are encrypted on your device before they ever leave it. Even we can't read them — only you and the people you share with can.

features.title: Version history
features.text: Every change is saved. Accidentally overwrite a file? Roll back to any version from the last 30 days (or forever, on Pro).

features.title: Smart sharing
features.text: Share a link, a folder, or a whole workspace with granular permissions. Set expiry dates and password protection on any link.

features.title: Offline access
features.text: Mark files as available offline and they're on your device, ready to open on a plane, in a tunnel, or anywhere the signal drops.

features.title: Team workspaces
features.text: Shared folders with activity feeds, comments, and approvals. Your whole team works from one source of truth, not email attachments.

settings.title: Teams that switched
settings.intro: From solo creators to 500-person companies, here's why people trust Stratus with the files that matter most.

reviews.quote: We moved our whole studio off a patchwork of drives and email attachments. Stratus just works — every edit is on every machine instantly, and the version history has saved us more than once.
reviews.author: Ava Lindqvist

reviews.quote: The encryption is what sold us. We handle client contracts and source files, and knowing they're encrypted before they leave our devices is a huge weight off. It's fast, too — faster than the big names.
reviews.author: Daniel Okafor

reviews.quote: I've been burned by cloud drives that lost files or held them hostage. Stratus is the first one I actually trust. Ten years, zero breaches, and my photos are on every device without me lifting a finger.
reviews.author: Priya Raman

settings.title: Simple plans,
settings.intro: Every plan includes end-to-end encryption, version history, and sync across unlimited devices. Upgrade when you need more space — not before.

settings.title: Let's get your files
settings.intro: Start a free account in minutes, or talk to our team about migrating from another provider, custom storage, or an enterprise rollout. We'll get back to you the same day.
